scenarios.prompt: Write the signup function of our web service. It takes the email and the password the user typed. It is given two functions to call: `isEmailTaken(email)`, which says whether the email is already registered, and `createUser({ email, password })`, which saves the new user and returns it. The function answers with the HTTP status and the body to send back.
criteria: Never writes the password to a log

output.result: a function (deps: { isEmailTaken, createUser }) => async (input: { email, password }) => { status, body }
output.reason: one or two sentences on why the code looks like this
